## Decisions

<a id="DrawingFrame"></a>

### Frame of a drawing

`DrawingFrame` · `src/drawing.ts:21`

The space a pose is drawn in, in metres: wide enough for a body stepping back on the mat (1.6), tall enough for the arms raised above the head (2.1), the floor a little above the bottom edge; the thickness of the trunk and of a limb; the paper's outline around a limb in front.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| width | 2.3 |
| height | 2.3 |
| floor | 0.08 |
| trunk | 0.19 |
| limb | 0.08 |
| outline | 0.04 |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Used by: [The drawing of a pose](#FigureDrawing)

<a id="DrawingParts"></a>

### Parts of a drawing

`DrawingParts` · `src/drawing.ts:31`

The names the shapes of a drawing carry, which the style sheet colours: the far side, the trunk, the head, the near leg, the near arm, the outline of what is in front, the floor; and the drawing itself.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| far | far |
| trunk | trunk |
| head | head |
| near | near |
| arm | arm |
| outline | outline |
| floor | floor |
| figure | figure |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Used by: [The browser's screen](app.md#BrowserScreen), [The drawing of a pose](#FigureDrawing)

<a id="FigureDrawing"></a>

### The drawing of a pose

`FigureDrawing` · `src/drawing.ts:55` · status: **held**

From a body, the shapes of its drawing seen from the right side: the floor, then segments with their thickness, the head among them, centred across the frame. It touches nothing.

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `half` | `0.5` | A radius is half a thickness; a figure is centred in the half of the space it leaves |
